author: hellas2900
quote: What isn't there to say about this game... First of all its too realistic, like why do I have to fuel up my car and eat and drink? Also doesnt feel like a GTA game since the woke development team basically created a simp main character with a girlboss girlfriend that you have to spend hours doing chores for to progress the story. The whole game is centered around your relationship with Lucia.... yeah sorry no one actually wants to have a female protagonist in a open world sandbox thats supposed to be centered around crime and violence. Additionally the game is just basically just a wholesome reddit simulator where you arent allowed to commit any crime or violence. Also runs like crap at less than 30fps most of the time, filled with bugs, really poor handling on the vehicles and movement style. Basically just a graphically impressive real life simulator where your trapped as a cuck to your girlboss torta and cant hurt anyone. Graphics look good and the music choices were great but this is what you get with a woke, feminist development team where basically all the work was outsourced to india.
